svg.title: Origin thresholds and locally verified secondary events across four load phases.
svg.desc: English: Origin thresholds and locally verified secondary events across four load phases. 繁體中文：四個負載相位的原點失穩門檻及局部驗證次級事件。

cc:Work.dc:description: Event loads across the four declared load phases. Panel (a) uses solid and dashed lines for the first and second origin instability loads. They do not depend on C or S, so each nonlinear coefficient set has the same threshold and is drawn only once per truncation. Panel (b) explicitly plots M4 minus M2 for the two thresholds, making the nearly coincident first thresholds checkable. Panel (c) uses verified, unduplicated nonzero events. Filled markers denote folds and open markers reflection-symmetric secondary events. Black outer rings identify additional folds verified in the separately recorded post-hoc saved-PAL-turn analysis, not events recovered by the frozen shared natural scout. These discoveries never update original method coverage, seeds or cost. Signed partners are one event orbit here. An absent marker is not proof of absence, and joining phases is not atlas-completeness certification. Higher-mode persistence remains separate.
